messages:
sophie: quick heads-up — onboarding raven-lite-v3-int8 to the dedicated canary. seeing ~38% funcall structured-output JSON parse failures when the kv-prefix is present (small prompts, 80–160 tokens).
sophie: root cause unclear but failures look like truncated suffix + occasional extra commas. logging attached.
ajay: can you paste a failing snippet?
maria: here's one from logs (raw model stream):
```
{
  "action": "create_ticket",
  "args": {
    "title": "Login error",
    "description": "User can't log in",
  }
}
```
maria: note the trailing comma after description — valid JS but invalid strict JSON parser.
derek: hmm int8 roundtrip likely altered tokenization around punctuation. also kv-prefix could be eating tokens and shifting boundaries causing premature EOS.
sophie: we also see outputs that look like two JSON objects concatenated: `{}\n{...}` which breaks our parser.
ajay: two quick mitigations to try: 1) soft-parse: accept JSON5-ish (trailing commas, single quotes) and repair; 2) retry-with-context: on parse fail, reissue a short retry prompt that asks for only the JSON object and insists on strict RFC-8259.
maria: I tried repair heuristics (strip trailing commas, wrap single quotes) on a 1k sample — repaired ~22% of failures but introduced 3% semantic errors (wrong arg types).
derek: repair is a slippery slope for correctness. prefer retries + stricter decoding constraints. what did retry budget look like?
sophie: current retry budget is 2 attempts with no backoff. latency spike acceptable for canary.
ajay: propose experiment: A/B with 10k requests each: A) disable kv-prefix for toolcall prompts, keep current retry=2; B) keep kv-prefix but upgrade retry to 4 with exponential backoff (200ms -> 600ms). also record parse_failure_reason and token index of first parse error.
maria: I'll add telemetry flags: parse_failure_reason (trailing_comma|truncated|concat|other), first_invalid_token_idx, model_temp, kv_prefix_len.
eval-bot: scheduled eval run: https://internal-evals/runs/2170001111 (canary: raven-lite-v3-int8) — will attach detailed heatmaps after run.
sophie: also want to test a "strict prompt wrapper" variant: prepend `Please output a single JSON object only. Do not add extra text.` and set top_p=0.7 — see if determinism improves.
derek: note: with quantized kernels, lower top_p can cause repetitive patterns. track semantics vs parse success separately.
ajay: timeline: start runs today (4h each), gather metrics + sampled outputs, then decide repair vs retry + prompt wrapper.
maria: onboarding checklist update: add parse-rescue telemetry, add JSON5-repair patch but gated behind rollout flag, add strict-prompt wrapper variant.
sophie: action items: @maria implement telemetry + harness; @ajay configure canary A/B and increased retry; @derek add model-invocation note about kv-prefix opt-out and tokenization test.
derek: noted, will add tokenization alignment tests to the runtime smoke.
sophie: thanks — we'll reconvene after eval-bot posts heatmaps. :thumbsup:
